title: Dispute and Verification Settings by Placement Stage (Placed Consumer Accounts)
content:
Compliance manual appendix for **Placed Consumer Accounts**. These are the stage settings used in handling disputes and validation information requests: whether a dispute by phone places a hold, how long the client has to supply verification, which verification package is mailed, how quickly verification is mailed once documents arrive, and how far back a prior verification makes a dispute a repeat dispute.

| Stage | A dispute received by phone places a dispute hold | Client verification due (calendar days after a hold-placing dispute) | Verification package mailed | Verification mailed within (business days after the client's documents arrive) | Repeat-dispute look-back (calendar days before the dispute) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Early-Out Placement | Yes | 10 | Itemized statement package | 3 | 90 |
| Primary Placement | No | 21 | Charge-off package | 5 | 120 |
| Secondary Placement | No | 30 | Charge-off package | 5 | 120 |
| Tertiary Placement | No | 30 | Chain-of-placement package | 5 | 120 |
| Warehouse Placement | No | 45 | Chain-of-placement package | 10 | 180 |
| Legal Review Placement | Yes | 15 | Legal documentation package | 3 | 120 |

## Column definitions

- **Phone dispute places a hold**: whether a dispute received by phone places the account in dispute hold at that stage.
- **Client verification due**: the calendar days after a hold-placing dispute within which the client must supply verification documents.
- **Verification package**: the verification document set mailed at that stage.
- **Verification mailing time**: the business days after the client's documents arrive within which verification is mailed.
- **Repeat-dispute look-back**: the calendar days before a dispute within which a prior verification on the same reason makes it a repeat dispute.

## Comparisons drawn from the table

- Only Early-Out Placement and Legal Review Placement treat a phone dispute as hold-placing.
- The client's verification deadline grows from 10 days at Early-Out Placement to 45 days at Warehouse Placement; Legal Review Placement sits at 15 days.
- Four packages are used: the itemized statement package (Early-Out Placement), the charge-off package (Primary Placement, Secondary Placement), the chain-of-placement package (Tertiary Placement, Warehouse Placement) and the legal documentation package (Legal Review Placement).
